prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: flat orthographic diffuse material texture, NOT an object illustration.
Generate one SQUARE seamless stone-carving texture for wrapping left-to-right around the circular shaft of a Huabiao-inspired Chinese milestone column. Render the UNWRAPPED shaft surface flat, straight-on, edge to edge: no visible cylindrical pillar, no side faces, no perspective, no pedestal, no cap, no cloudboard, no beast or figurine, no floor and no scenery. The whole image is the material itself.

Carved ivory and pale warm-greige sandstone, with delicately worn natural stone grain. Softly painted premium academy illustration quality matching only the material finish of the reference image; do NOT copy its landscape, staircase or saturated colors. One tasteful long CHINESE DRAGON relief winds diagonally upward through rounded traditional Chinese auspicious cloud curls, expressing an ascending coiled dragon carved into the shaft. Anatomically clear Chinese dragon head, sinuous scaled body, whiskers and small claws; refined architectural relief rather than a cartoon mascot. Keep the dragon and clouds carved from the SAME ivory stone. Raised dragon scales and ridges are slightly lighter ivory; recessed cloud curls are subtly darker greige. Moderate readable detail and soft carved edges. No black contour outlines, metallic gold or saturated paint.

Flat even diffuse ambient illumination across the ENTIRE square: no top-to-bottom or side-to-side lighting gradient, no directional cast shadows, no spot lighting, no vignette. Only restrained tiny local recess shading within the carving so the pattern remains visible. Material must repeat SEAMLESSLY along left and right edges at exactly the same tonal value, with cloud/dragon-contour continuity across the wrap seam. Do not add any border, frame, bands, lines, plaque, lettering, numerals, symbols, UI, watermark or background. Opaque albedo texture, intended for actual 3D geometry to supply shape, perspective and lighting. Square around1536×1536.
